name: Paze
desc: Bank-backed US online checkout wallet that lets consumers pay with their bank-issued cards without sharing card numbers with retailers.
customers: US consumers holding cards of participating banks; merchants such as United Airlines, Sephora, Dunkin' and Wendy's
parent_ultimate: Early Warning Services consortium (Bank of America, Capital One, JPMorgan Chase, PNC, Truist, US Bank, Wells Fargo)
marketing_autonomy_basis: own brand and general manager; buys its own NBA jersey-patch rights
parent_backing: developed and operated by Early Warning Services, owned by seven large US banks (Wikipedia)
qualifying_metric: Route C: 165 million enrolled cards and named enterprise merchants, plus paid NBA jersey-patch sponsorship

alt_indicators.evidence: about 165 million debit and credit cards after Citibank joined in March 2026
United Airlines, Sephora, Dunkin', Wendy's; Nuvei distribution to about 100,000 merchants (2025)
Atlanta Hawks jersey patch for five NBA seasons from 2025; Phoenix Suns jersey patch listed

signals.what: Distribution partnership with Nuvei adding about 100,000 merchants
Atlanta Hawks five-season jersey patch deal
Citibank begins offering Paze, taking reach to about 165 million cards

fit_rationale: New bank-backed wallet buying awareness through two NBA patches; three US Grands Prix and F1's US fan growth fit a checkout brand still building consumer recognition against card-network and fintech rivals.
category_conflict: potential: payments category crowded (card networks and fintechs hold team deals)

access.roles: General Manager Paze, CMO Early Warning Services

outstanding: no revenue or marketing budget published; Paze is a product brand of Early Warning Services rather than a separate company

name: Calimax

products: supermarkets, discount stores, wholesale (Bodegón), convenience formats; Smart & Final JV with Chedraui
stores_or_sites: 97 stores (article text; 105 branches in Baja California in 2023); distribution centre with 200+ trucks
qualifying_metric: Route C: 6,500 employees and about 100 stores

alt_indicators.evidence: 105 branches in Baja California in 2023 (97 in the lead)
